```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The COVID-19 pandemic exposed vulnerabilities of people residing in institutional settings, such as nursing homes and independent living facilities.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Biases within Medicaid create undue barriers to home- and community-based long-term services and supports.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will work to eliminate waiting lists for home and community-based care.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will work to eliminate the institutional bias within Medicaid.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will make investments in building the capacity of the Medicaid system to provide home and community-based services.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will modernize Medicaid eligibility so people with disabilities do not have to work low-wage jobs to access needed services.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will ensure the spouses of people with disabilities can maintain a certain level of income and assets.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will help Americans pay for long-term care by creating a tax credit for informal and family caregivers.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will help Americans pay for long-term care by increasing the Child and Dependent Care Tax Credit.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will pursue policies to improve nursing home staffing and quality standards.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will strengthen accreditation processes.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will combat corporate abuses in nursing homes and independent living facilities.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats are strongly committed to protecting and enforcing the Americans with Disabilities Act.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats are strongly committed to fulfilling the promise of the Olmstead v. L.C. decision, which found institutional segregation of people with disabilities to be unlawful.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
